infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take your check-in selfie or video, if your employer asks for one, or a photo of a bill or place to save with its location.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo for your profile or a photo note.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Share this phone's location with your employer's VeeTrax fleet account while tracking is switched on, save the place where a photo note was taken and show your position.

plugins.faceIDPermission: VeeTrax Tracker keeps your sign-in in the iPhone's secure storage. It does not use Face ID.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: VeeTrax Tracker shares this phone's location with your employer's VeeTrax fleet account, including in the background when the app is closed, while tracking is switched on.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: VeeTrax Tracker shares this phone's location with your employer's VeeTrax fleet account, including in the background when the app is closed, while tracking is switched on.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Share this phone's location with your employer's VeeTrax fleet account while tracking is switched on, save the place where a photo note was taken and show your position.
plugins.motionUsagePermission: VeeTrax Tracker does not read your motion or fitness data.

plugins.cameraPermission: VeeTrax Tracker uses the camera for your check-in selfie or video, if your employer asks for one, your profile photo, and photos of bills or places saved with their location.
plugins.microphonePermission: VeeTrax Tracker records check-in videos without sound. It does not use the microphone.
